evals.name: greenfield-evolve-real-code
evals.prompt: Work only in the assigned temporary output directory. Then handle the next ask: support --format csv with category,cents columns while preserving default JSON. Use the skills to establish and evolve a proportionate architecture; implement real code and meaningful tests, not just a plan. Save the runnable final product under outputs/project and response.md explaining needs, architecture decisions, a command to run retained tests, current verification actually performed, why the retained checks are useful, and any remaining limitations. Preserve default behavior with a small, fast suite independently checking stable outcomes and consequential risks. Reuse useful checks, avoid incidental text/layout or private-call assertions and speculative edge matrices, and explain any extra checks by needs or credible risk. Retain useful code/tests and current intent after delegated disposal. Current verification is observable by rerunning the suite; no proof of phase order is required.
assertions: The final product passes all independent acceptance_test.py checks for JSON, CSV, empty months, and invalid months.
Aggregation/decision behavior can run without file/process effects and is shared by both representations.
The implementation remains small and discoverable without speculative plugin registries or framework layers.
Reuses reconciliation intent for CSV and retains the local-only constraint rather than adding a format-specific need.
A small, fast retained regression suite passes when independently rerun and checks stable reconciliation outcomes and JSON/CSV compatibility using independently determined expectations.

Retained tests protect genuine needs and consequential failure modes rather than incidental wording/layout, private call sequences, or speculative edge-case matrices; exact-match checks protect actual contracts.

The final product retains useful code/tests and current intent with no leftover OW change records; its report identifies current verification and remaining limitations without claiming historical execution order as independently proven.

evals.name: strategic-test-selection
evals.prompt: Read-only verification planning; do not implement or invent execution results. Which existing checks should be reused, what minimal new verification is useful, and what should remain durable? Explain any limitation. Save response.md only.
evals.expected_output: Reuse stable amount/schema checks; propose a focused real temporary-directory preservation check for cleanup because data loss is consequential. Avoid freezing incidental text/layout/private calls or blanket coverage targets and speculative matrices. Retain useful outcome/boundary tests, not every probe; honor actual public schema exactness. Report supplied versus unperformed verification honestly.
assertions: Reuses existing charge-outcome and public-schema checks without requiring new tests merely for helper renames or module moves.
Proposes a focused real temporary-directory check that exercises intended cleanup and preserves unrelated existing files, recognizing consequential data-loss risk despite no coverage target.
Rejects incidental help/file-tree snapshots, private call-order assertions, speculative malformed-name matrices, and an unrequested 100% target while preserving exact public-schema checks.
Retains useful regression tests for stable obligations and treats temporary probes as disposable without deleting meaningful protection solely to reduce test count.
Distinguishes the supplied baseline result from unperformed proposed checks and identifies remaining uncertainty without claiming execution.

Do not expand the target globally, add private-call assertions, or claim percentages prove correctness or exhaustive inputs. No fabricated measurement.
assertions: Honors the explicitly requested 100% branch-coverage target for the refund module without expanding it to the whole application.
Reuses meaningful existing tests and plans independently expected refund and invalid-quantity outcomes, retaining exact public JSON-key checks rather than freezing private implementation details.
Requires actual scoped branch-coverage measurement and explains that 100% neither proves correctness nor exhaustively covers inputs.
Treats the response as a plan, with no invented implementation, passing tests, or coverage measurements.

C-001 is an in-progress, fast-forward change originally authorized to let one player complete one production recipe in the browser. In subsequent messages the owner requested a plan for intercity freight, regional retail, employment/payroll, and native app distribution, all under already-current needs; the agent appended these to T-003/T-004 and kept the original five-task list. Prepare/resume only original authorized work; future additions remain planning-only and default review. Successor prerequisites survive cleanup through delivered capabilities, without losing obligations.
assertions: Separates freight, regional retail, employment/payroll and native distribution from the original single-recipe delivery instead of expanding broad task acceptance to contain them.
Proposes completing T-002 with evidence attributed to the actual supplied timed-completion decision, removes its stale blocking effect, and preserves implementation work as unfinished.
Retains the unperformed T-005 manual observation and T-001 completion evidence; does not mark moved or unverified work done or drop it to achieve closure.
Reconciles scoped tasks and local dependencies, then resumes T-003/T-004 subject to actual verification under existing authority without redundant decision questions.
Keeps requested future direction in specific lightweight open changes with prerequisite capabilities and normal review, without inheriting C-001 fast-forward or authorizing later implementation.
Explains how successor obligations and prerequisite descriptions survive C-001 cleanup using retained future changes and delivered code/interfaces/checks, without cross-change task dependencies.
